VOL. I,  SECTION 2. 
 INSTRUCTIONS TO BIDDERS 
 
A. GENERAL 
1 Scope of Bid 
 
1.1 Project Background 
 
I. Siliguri Satellite Township Project (SSTP), Mouza – Binnaguri, JL No. 3, P.S. – 
Rajgunj, District – Jalpaiguri.  
1.1 SCOPE OF WORK 
The West Bengal Housing Board (WBHB) intends to undertake the development of the subject 
land into a planned residential plot scheme comprising plots of different sizes, together with the 
necessary internal infrastructure and allied development works, for subsequent disposal/sale of 
the developed plots. 
The Consultant shall provide comprehensive consultancy services covering pre-development 
investigation, planning and architectural plotting, infrastructure planning and design, 
preparation of Detailed Project Report (DPR), detailed engineering design, drawings, 
specifications, estimates, Bill of Quantities (BOQ), as applicable. 
The scope of consultancy shall broadly be divided into the following two stages: 
 Stage–1: Preparation of Draft Technical Report(s) and Preliminary Development 
Proposal 
 Stage–2: Preparation of Detailed Project Report (DPR), Detailed Engineering 
Design, Drawings, Estimates and Tender Documents 
The scope described herein is indicative and shall include all allied, incidental and necessary 
activities required for comprehensive planning and development of the project, whether or not 
specifically mentioned below. 
 
STAGE–1: PREPARATION OF DRAFT TECHNICAL REPORTS AND 
PRELIMINARY DEVELOPMENT PROPOSAL 
The Consultant shall undertake all necessary investigations, surveys, studies and preliminary 
designs and shall prepare Draft Technical Reports covering, but not limited to, the following: 
1. Pre-Development / Pre-Construction Survey and Site Investigation 
The Consultant shall undertake a detailed reconnaissance and pre-development survey of the 
entire project site. 
The survey and investigation shall, inter alia, include: 
a) Detailed topographical survey of the entire land parcel, including existing ground levels, 
contours, natural drainage pattern, existing structures, roads, trees, water bodies, utility lines, 
electric poles, drains, boundary features and other physical features. 
b) Establishment of appropriate benchmarks and reference coordinates for subsequent design 
and construction activities. 
c) Identification and verification of existing approach roads, adjoining roads and connectivity to 
the project site. 
d) Identification of existing utility infrastructure and services within and around the site, 
including water supply, electricity, drainage, sewerage, telecommunications, etc. 
e) Assessment of site constraints, existing encroachments, easements, right-of-way, natural 
drainage, low-lying areas and other features which may affect development. 
f) Collection and review of available land records, cadastral/site plans and other relevant 
documents supplied by WBHB. 
g) Preparation of a detailed Site Survey Report, incorporating survey drawings, site 
photographs, observations, constraints and recommendations. 
Where required for engineering design, the Consultant shall also recommend/undertake 
necessary California Bearing Ratio(CBR) for road work, material investigation and other 
site-specific investigations, either directly or through suitably qualified agencies. 
All survey drawings shall be prepared in appropriate engineering/architectural scales and 
submitted in both editable soft-copy and hard-copy formats. 
 
2. Preliminary Land Use Planning and Architectural Layout of Plots 
The Consultant shall prepare a comprehensive preliminary land-use and plot development plan 
for the entire project land. 
The development proposal shall comprise two(02) categories of residential plots: 
Type–A: Plot area approximately 2.5 to 3.0 Katha 
Type–B: Plot area approximately 3.5 to 4.0 Katha 
The proposed number of Type–A and Type–B plots should be maintained in a ratio of 1:1, 
subject to site conditions, applicable planning norms, statutory requirements and optimization of 
the developable area. 
The Consultant shall: 
a) Prepare an optimum plotting scheme for the entire land parcel. 
b) Ensure proper access, road connectivity, circulation and functional planning of the plots. 
c) Provide regular rectangular or near-rectangular plot shapes. 
d) Ensure adequate frontage and access to each saleable plot. 
e) Clearly demarcate plot boundaries, plot numbers, plot dimensions and areas. 
f) Provide adequate provisions for roads, open spaces, utility areas, drainage, community 
facilities and other mandatory/non-saleable areas, as applicable. 
g) Optimize the number of saleable plots while ensuring compliance with applicable 
statutory /planning requirements. 
h) Provide Open Green spaces for recreation and space for community activity as per  
standard NBC norms. 
i) Prepare a Plot Schedule indicating plot number, plot type, dimensions and area. 
j) Provide a detailed statement showing the total land area, saleable plot area, road area, 
open space/amenity area, utility area and other areas, as applicable. 
The preliminary plotting plan shall be submitted for approval of WBHB before proceeding to 
detailed design. 
 
 
 
 
3. Layout and Design of Internal Road Network 
The Consultant shall prepare the preliminary layout and engineering design of the internal road 
network serving all proposed plots. 
The scope shall include: 
a) Preparation of a complete internal road network plan showing formation width including 
carriageway shoulder and drainage, junctions, turning arrangements and all other 
necessary access to individual plots. 
b) Geometric Design of rigid pavement/internal roads (Minimum Carriage way width 7.0 
m.) in accordance with applicable IRC/MoRTH and other relevant standards and 
specifications, as applicable. 
c) The carriageway width shall be designed to facilitate safe movement of emergency/fire-
fighting vehicles and other essential service vehicles and shall comply with applicable 
statutory requirements. 
d) Provision of appropriate road shoulders, kerbs as specified  by latest IRC specifications 
e) Provision of a cycling track/cycle way alongside the carriageway, wherever feasible 
and appropriate to the site as specified  by latest IRC specifications 
f) Preparation of preliminary road cross-sections, longitudinal profiles, levels and 
pavement proposals as specified  by latest IRC specifications. 
g) Integration of the road levels with the overall site grading and storm-water drainage 
system. 
4. Internal Drainage, Sewerage and Solid Waste Management System 
The Consultant shall prepare a comprehensive preliminary plan for internal drainage and waste 
management infrastructure. 
The system shall include, but not be limited to: 
a) Storm-water drainage network. 
b) Surface water drainage from roads, plots and common areas. 
c) Sewerage and sullage system. 
d) Collection and disposal/treatment arrangement for sewage and sullage if applicable. 
e) Solid waste collection and disposal arrangements if applicable.

पश्चिम बंगाल आवास बोर्ड (WBHB) ने कंसल्टेंसी सेवाओं को आउटसोर्स करने के लिए एक ई-कोटेशन नोटिस (NIeQ No: WBHB/DD(EW)II/NIeQ-14/2025-2026) जारी किया है। इस परियोजना में जलपाईगुड़ी स्थित सिलीगुड़ी सैटेलाइट टाउनशिप प्रोजेक्ट (SSTP) में लगभग 7.05 एकड़ भूमि पर विभिन्न श्रेणियों के भूखंडों के लेआउट और संबंधित बुनियादी ढांचे के विकास के लिए व्यापक परामर्श सेवाएं शामिल हैं।

en_body:
The West Bengal Housing Board (WBHB) has issued an e-Quotation notice (NIeQ No: WBHB/DD(EW)II/NIeQ-14/2025-2026) inviting online bids for outsourcing consultancy services. The project involves comprehensive consultancy for developing a layout of plots with associated infrastructural facilities on approximately 7.05 acres of land at the Siliguri Satellite Township Project (SSTP) in Jalpaiguri.

## Project and Tender Details
- **Issuing Authority:** West Bengal Housing Board (WBHB)
- **Location:** Siliguri Satellite Township Project (SSTP), Mouza – Binnaguri, JL No. 3, P.S. – Rajgunj, District – Jalpaiguri
- **Scheme Name:** Comprehensive Consultancy for development of layout for plots with associated infrastructure
- **Plot Types:** Residential plots categorized into Type-A (approx. 2.5 to 3.0 Katha) and Type-B (approx. 3.5 to 4.0 Katha), maintained in a roughly 1:1 ratio
- **Estimated Period of Completion:** 2 months
- **Earnest Money Deposit (EMD):** Rs. 30,000.00 to be deposited online (Net banking / NEFT / RTGS)

## Important Dates & Schedule
- **NIeQ Publishing Date:** 09.09.2026 at 14:00 HRS
- **Start of Bid Downloading:** 09.09.2026 at 14:00 HRS
- **Pre-Bid Meeting Date:** 15.09.2026 at 13:00 HRS at the Board Room, WBHB, 'ABASAN', 2nd floor, 105, SN Banerjee Road, Kolkata-700014
- **Bid Submission Start Date:** 16.09.2026 at 14:00 HRS
- **Bid Submission Closing Date:** 25.09.2026 at 14:00 HRS
- **Technical Bid Opening Date:** 28.09.2026 at 14:00 HRS
- **Financial Bid Opening Date:** To be notified during technical evaluation

## Eligibility and Verification
Eligible bidders include bonafide and resourceful agencies having experience in similar natures of service and fulfilling criteria such as technical capability (personnel with requisite degrees and 10 years experience) and financial capacity (successfully completing at least two projects of a cumulative value of not less than INR 5 crores during the last three financial years). Interested consultants must verify original notices and documents directly through official portals.

- **Official Notice Link:** [WBHB Current Tenders](https://wbhousingboard.in/home/current_tenders/download/wbhb_nieq_14_08_09_2026.pdf)
- **Application Portal:** [WB e-Tender Portal](http://etender.wb.nic.in)
